newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's to offer Happy Meal Toddler Toys.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's to offer Happy Meal Toddler Toys.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said Thursday it partnered with Fisher-Price, a unit of toymaker Mattel Inc, to offer "Toddler Toys" in its Happy Meals for children.

McDonald's said the Toddler Toys are designed for children under age three. It said up to 24 different Fisher-Price toys will be available exclusively with Happy Meals throughout the next year. More designs will be available the following year.

McDonald's said the Toddler Toys include miniature versions of Fisher-Price's crib, playpen and preschool lines including the Chatter Telephone, a rotary phone on wheels, and the Bead Ball, a ball with colorful beads that slide and rattle.
McDonald's said all its Happy Meal give-away toys safety-tested for children of all ages.
McDonald's has more than 19,200 restaurants in 94 countries.
